translations.1. В командной строке установите движок::
1. In a terminal install the engine: python -m pip install argostranslate.
2. Point the Python field to the same python.exe and click Check Argos.
3. Download a .argosmodel for the right direction, e.g. ru → en for Russian → English.
4. Click Install .argosmodel…, choose the file and check the model list.
5. In Translate text choose Local Argos and the source/target language codes.
Check LibreTranslate only if you run that separate server; it is not needed for local mode.
